root_text:
Unger: So, Andrea, why is it making news now?

Garcia: cases have been increasing, & Chinese authorities have said that HMPV cases could spike even more during the Lunar New Year holiday, which we know is at the end of this month.

nodes.text:
We also know from recent articles that levels are currently high in the UK, which is often indicative of what we can expect here.
According to an article last updated on Sunday, Britain is on high alert as cases have surged, prompting both health warning and calls for masking.
